preconditions.description: The dimensions of the table are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in table)
preconditions.description: Each row in the table has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in 'DIMA' for row in table for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the table contains one of the letters 'D', 'I', 'M', 'A'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Poor Dima!' if max_dima_count == 0 else stdout == 'Poor Inna!' if max_dima_count == float('inf') else stdout == str(max_dima_count)
postconditions.description: The output is 'Poor Dima!' if no DIMA sequence can be found, 'Poor Inna!' if an infinite DIMA sequence exists, otherwise the maximum number of DIMA sequences.
